content: h07. **The request path** — the browser gets the avatar URL from the API as `/file/users/{username}/avatar` (`convertUserFromStore` rewrites base64 avatars into that path at `server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36`), then `` in `web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx:14` issues a plain GET. Avatar bytes are stored **inline in the `user` row as a base64 data URI**, not as a file or attachment — so the "image" hop is a column read, not a blob store read. **Hops:** ``` UserAvatar (img src) — web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx:8 GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124 (RegisterRoutes) FileServerService.serveUserAvatar — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 FileServerService.getCurrentUser — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708 [gate; only when !Profile.AllowAnonymous()] Authenticator.AuthenticateToUser — server/auth/authenticator.go:190 [same conditional branch] FileServerService.getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715 Store.GetUser — store/user.go:148 Store.ListUsers — store/user.go:136 Driver.ListUsers (interface) — store/driver.go:47 DB.ListUsers (SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 · store/db/postgres/user.go:87 · store/db/mysql/user.go:84 table user.avatar_url — store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:20 (also postgres/mysql LATEST.sql:9) FileServerService.parseDataURI — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737 [decode base64 → bytes] c.Blob(200, imageType, imageData) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:209 ``` **Details worth noting:** - **Two branches, one store call.** The authentication hop (`getCurrentUser` → `AuthenticateToUser`) fires only on private instances (`s.Profile.AllowAnonymous()` false, `fileserver.go:173`). On a public instance another user's avatar is served anonymously. Either way there is no per-user authorization check on the avatar itself — any resolvable username's avatar is served. - **Lookup is username-only.** `getUserByUsername` passes `store.FindUser{Username: &identifier}` (`fileserver.go:716`), so the `:identifier` path segment must be the username, not the numeric ID. - **The user cache is bypassed on this path.** `Store.GetUser` only consults `s.userCache` when `find.ID != nil` (`store/user.go:149`); a username lookup always falls through to `ListUsers` → SQL. The row is written *into* cache afterward (`store/user.go:143`), but every avatar request costs a query. - **Data-layer fan-out is a three-dialect interface.** `store/driver.go:47` is the contract; sqlite/postgres/mysql each implement `ListUsers` with the same column list including `avatar_url`. - **Type allowlist is enforced at serve time, not just upload.** `avatarAllowedTypes` (`fileserver.go:75`) re-checks the decoded MIME type after `parseDataURI`, mirroring the upload-side check in `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go:343` — defense in depth against rows written before validation existed.
